translation.semantics: A filtered mirror of verified grammar items. It excludes F3, F4, and explainer formats, requires text, at least four target-language words, deduplication, and existing target-language drill audio. It reinforces but never adds a structural objective. The DE/FR/IT/PT translation builds predate the current grammar builds, so no current-unit inclusion is inferred from their deck totals.

commands.objective: Imperatives combined with human recipients, direct objects, indirect objects, and in Romance languages clitic placement or clusters.
General affirmative and negative commands in topical discourse, with occasional hortative first-person-plural intent.

pronouns.objective: Recipient, direct-object, indirect-object, and double-object pronouns across varied finite and modal clauses.
A human matrix object plus an embedded non-human object in object-control, infinitive, or finite-complement constructions.
Singular recipients, tonic/prepositional complements, and explicit formal-address contrasts.

relfexive.objective: Finite self-directed or lexically pronominal constructions across persons.
Infinitive and lexical pronominality choices, often signaled only by the target-language references.
relfexive.quality_note: The remaining 49 English prompts are not explicit reflexive cues; many are underspecified or unidiomatic as English.

relfexive.objective: Vocative plural commands, not a reflexive block.

status_definitions.covered: A currently delivered, verified objective directly teaches every core structural axis of the entire source-row bucket.
status_definitions.partial: At least one core structural axis of the bucket is currently delivered, but another material axis is absent or only narrowly sampled.
status_definitions.gap: No currently delivered objective teaches the bucket's defining structure.
status_definitions.misfiled: The rows belong to another structural topic and are excluded from the named topic's coverage denominator.
status_definitions.counting_rule: Counts are bucket-sized source-row equivalents, not counts of legacy rows approved for reuse. Every bucket is assigned as a whole to avoid false row-level precision from defective reference translations.

quality_caveats.finding: The prior audit estimates 5-10 percent defects in old translations and documents machine-English, literal calques, and register inconsistency. Exact source references are therefore diagnostic evidence, never authoritative answers.
Spanish COMMANDS use formal usted while Spanish PRONOUNS use informal tu; Portuguese COMMANDS mix imperative and bare infinitive. A new unit must choose its register independently.
P2 repeats an embedded English it in all 50 rows, while P3 is a 50-row recipient template with recurring unidiomatic English double-object frames. These blocks show objectives, not reusable prose.

R3 contains 50 vocative plural commands and only two explicit English reflexive pronouns. R2 contains only one explicit English reflexive pronoun. Target-language pronominal forms cannot repair an underspecified English cue.

The old Italian estate was a French copy and is absent from the fresh snapshot. The repaired Italian output is valuable for identifying structural intent but has no estate-study provenance and is not an import source.
All 12 matching DE/ES/FR/PT legacy decks have zero reps, zero reviews, zero mature cards, and zero sound tags. There is no scheduling or audio value to preserve.

methodology: Hash and parse the five canonical input files and five repaired-Italian output files; require contiguous IDs, 400 unique canonical rows, four nonempty reference translations per input row, and a one-to-one 400-ID Italian join.

Inspect every canonical English prompt in ID order. Use DE/ES/FR/PT references and repaired Italian only to disambiguate the intended target-language construction, never to certify wording or correctness.

Assign contiguous 50-row authored blocks to the structural buckets C1-C2, P1-P3, and R1-R3. Record mechanically reproducible traits such as negative commands, explicit formal markers, explicit reflexive pronouns, and the 50-row command contamination.

Read the committed curriculum, relevant deterministic banks, translation selector, Tenses Rescue profile, five learner error profiles, Italian taxonomy, estate manifest, roadmap, prior audit, and commission at the hashes in this artifact.
